dedupe_keys.name: dataset of innovative air duct enhanced thermal management and natural convection heat transfer intensification in the busbar compartment of an air insulated medium voltage switchgear

description: Lubomír Klimeš and colleagues publish experimental and numerical results for cooling the busbar compartment of air-insulated medium-voltage switchgear. The September 2025 deposit includes four CSV result files alongside schematics, photographs and plotted results. A public README maps each file to these roles and confirms CC BY 4.0; downloads are free. The study compares air-duct designs using multiphysics simulations and standardised temperature-rise tests. These outputs can help calibrate equipment thermal models or compare cooling assumptions in electricity-asset simulations. Detailed units and CSV field definitions are deferred to the associated Case Studies in Thermal Engineering paper. Test dates, uncertainty and complete solver configurations are not established by the metadata. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this equipment study. The published numerical tables were not downloaded and the claimed thermal improvement was not reproduced.
